body: Free standard shipping on US orders over $50; otherwise a flat $4.95. Standard delivery is 3-5 business days.
We ship worldwide, including Canada, the UK, the EU and Australia. International delivery takes 7-14 business days; import duties may apply.
Express shipping (2 business days) is available at checkout for $14.95.
When your order ships we email you a tracking link. You can also track it anytime from your account under 'Orders'.
We accept returns within 30 days of delivery for a full refund. Items must be unused with original tags attached.
Size exchanges are free within 30 days and we cover return shipping on your first exchange.
Refunds are issued within 5-7 business days after we receive your return, back to your original payment method.
Return shipping is free for exchanges. For refunds a $5 label fee is deducted, unless the item arrived faulty.
Our clothing runs true to size. Check the size chart on each product page; if you're between sizes, size up.
Shoes run true to size. If you have wide feet we recommend going half a size up.
Hand wash cold or use a wool cycle, then lay flat to dry. Do not tumble dry merino wool items.
Wipe waterproof gear clean and reproof it with a spray-on DWR coating each season. Do not iron.
We accept Visa, Mastercard, Amex, Apple Pay, Google Pay and Shop Pay.
You can pay in 4 interest-free installments with Shop Pay on orders over $50.
New customers get 10% off their first order with code WELCOME10 at checkout.
Digital gift cards from $25 to $200 are delivered by email and never expire.
You can change or cancel an order within 1 hour of placing it by contacting support; after that it may have already shipped.
All products carry a 1-year warranty against manufacturing defects.
Reach us at support@shop.example or via live chat, Monday to Friday, 9am-6pm.
Our packaging is 100% recyclable and we offset the carbon of every shipment.
If your package is lost or arrives damaged, contact us within 7 days with a photo and we'll send a replacement or refund.
If tracking shows delivered but you didn't receive it, check with neighbours, then contact us — we'll open a claim with the carrier.
We can update your shipping address only before the order ships. Contact support quickly with your order number.
Out-of-stock items show a 'notify me' option; we'll email you when they're back. Popular items typically restock within 2-3 weeks.
Earn 1 point per $1 spent; 100 points = $5 off. Points appear in your account after each order.
If an item goes on sale within 7 days of your purchase, contact us for a one-time price adjustment.
For orders over 50 units, email wholesale@shop.example for bulk pricing and lead times.
Material details are listed on each product page. Our wool is responsibly sourced and our cotton is certified organic.
We never sell your data. You can request deletion of your personal data anytime by emailing privacy@shop.example.
Local pickup is available at our warehouse Mon-Fri 10am-4pm; choose 'pickup' at checkout and wait for the ready email.
